optimize.ready_description: Vyberte zbraň a upravte priority pro optimální sestavu
optimize.evo_ergo_tooltip: When on, the ergonomics weight optimizes weight-adjusted ergonomics instead of raw ergo: the solver tries several ergo-per-kg exchange rates and keeps the build with the best EvoErgoDelta (distance from the overswing threshold). The EvoErgo stat shown is the community metric ergo − 15 × weight (kg). Based on SpaceMonkey37’s EvoErgo.
optimize.tchebycheff_tooltip: Optimalizuje pro vyvážené sestavy s vysokou efektivitou vyvážením ergonomie, zpětného rázu a ceny.

constraints.exact_moa_floor_tooltip: When on, the slider minimum is computed by actually solving for the best achievable MOA (slower, exact). When off, the minimum is a theoretical estimate that may not be reachable in practice.
constraints.prevent_overswing_tooltip: Vynucuje, aby celková hmotnost zbraně zůstala pod prahem setrvačnosti míření pro dané vybavení.
constraints.equip_ergo_penalty_tooltip: Kombinovaný postih k ergonomii od brnění, helmy a batohu v procentech (např. -15 % až -20 % pro těžké brnění).

methodology.title: Guide & Methodology
methodology.ergo_desc: In Escape from Tarkov, raw Ergonomics directly controls the ADS (Aim Down Sights) animation duration and the audio cue loudness when scoping in.
methodology.evo_ergo_desc_1: Research by SpaceMonkey37 and EFTForge revealed that heavy weapons carry rotational inertia during fast mouse flick turns, overshooting the crosshair. The overswing threshold weight follows a quadratic curve:
methodology.evo_ergo_desc_2: EvoErgoDelta (EED) measures the distance from the overswing threshold:
methodology.eed_positive: EED ≥ 0: Crosshair snaps instantly without inertia float or momentum drift.
methodology.eed_negative: EED < 0: Weapon exhibits crosshair momentum overswing on flick shots.
methodology.equip_penalty_desc_1: Equipped body armor, helmets, rigs, and backpacks impose percentage ergonomics penalties (e.g. -15% to -20% for heavy armor), lowering effective ergonomics and reducing the threshold weight:
methodology.equip_penalty_desc_2: With Prevent Overswing enabled and your gear penalty set, the solver dynamically computes cutting planes using effective ergonomics to guarantee zero overswing in actual combat gear.
methodology.moa_desc: Tarkov uses internal centerOfImpact (COI) units, converted to in-game MOA (Minute of Angle) via the empirical constant ≈ 34.3:
methodology.moa_barrel_note: For weapons with replaceable barrels (e.g. M700, VPO-215), installing a barrel replaces the intrinsic weapon COI.
methodology.mip_desc: The entire modding slot dependency tree, parent-child linkages, conflict matrices, and preset bundles are compiled into a CPLEX LP formulation solved via HiGHS WASM directly in a browser Web Worker with zero backend round-trips.
methodology.sweet_spot_alert_title: Why standard weighted sums miss 45%–61% of optimal builds
methodology.sweet_spot_alert_desc: In standard weighted sum optimization, the objective is a flat rotating hyperplane. Because weapon mod trees feature discrete prerequisites and step-function pricing, the Pareto frontier is non-convex. Flat hyperplanes can only touch the outer convex hull, jumping abruptly between budget and meta builds while skipping high-efficiency intermediate configurations.
methodology.sweet_spot_how: Augmented Tchebycheff scalarization minimizes the maximum normalized gap (L_∞ norm) from the Ideal Point:
methodology.sweet_spot_contour: Because its contours are L-shaped corner boxes, Augmented Tchebycheff can corner into non-convex pockets, mathematically proven to reach 100% of true Pareto-optimal builds.
methodology.explore_desc: In the Explore Tab, AUGMECON2 (Augmented ε-Constraint with Slack-Bypass) dynamically jumps over empty plateaus and adds an augmentation term to guarantee strict non-dominance, generating dense tradeoff curves in seconds.
methodology.overswing_cuts_desc: Because the threshold curve is strictly convex, the solver generates exact first-order tangent cutting planes at the optimal ergonomics level, converging in 1–2 fast iterations without extra binary variables.
methodology.data_source_desc: All weapon and mod data is fetched from the Tarkov.dev open JSON API (171 weapons, 2,295 attachments, and barter tables).
methodology.flea_desc: Uses 24-hour average and last low price.
methodology.trader_desc: Strict gating for Prapor, Skier, Peacekeeper, Mechanic, Jaeger, and Ref (LL1–4 or Off).
methodology.barter_desc: Calculated as the total flea market value of required trade-in items.
methodology.presets_desc: The optimizer evaluates both stripped naked receivers and trader weapon presets. If a preset is selected, its included parts are marked as retained (₽0), preventing double-counting.
methodology.cache_desc: Game data is cached in IndexedDB for 1 hour. If a game patch drops, click the top-right Force Refresh button to purge local storage, restart the worker, and download fresh data.
methodology.glossary_eed_desc: The margin between weapon weight and the overswing threshold for its ergonomics. Positive = clean snap; negative = inertia overswing. Every 15 EED equals 1.0kg of weight buffer.
methodology.glossary_evo_desc: Community composite metric: min(100, Ergo) - 15 · Weight(kg), balancing ADS speed and lightweight handling.
methodology.glossary_moa_desc: Measure of weapon mechanical spread. Lower is more accurate (1 MOA ≈ 1 inch spread at 100 yards).
methodology.glossary_tch_desc: A mathematical scalarization method for non-convex multi-objective optimization that minimizes the worst-case normalized gap from the ideal reference point.
methodology.glossary_forge_desc: Export any optimized build directly to EFTForge with a single click to inspect visual layouts and detailed gear simulations.
methodology.precision_intro: In weapon modding, accessories (such as flashlights, lasers, backup sights, and rail mounts) can fit into multiple candidate slots across different handguards and adapters. This is the multi-slot assignment problem:
methodology.precision_fast: Fast Mode: Uses lightweight slot mutex relaxation, solving in milliseconds with ~99% optimality.
methodology.precision_precise: Precise Mode: Instantiates full discrete placement variables (p_item_slot) for all multi-slot items, guaranteeing strict CP-SAT constraint programming equivalence.
methodology.precision_auto: Auto Mode (Default): Intelligently switches based on weapon mod tree size. Compact trees (≤ 220 reachable mods, e.g. SMGs, DMRs, pistols) run in Precise Mode, while massive trees (M4A1, AK-74) run in Fast Mode to deliver fluid real-time responses.
methodology.glossary_precision_desc: Controls the depth of multi-slot integer variable formulation. Auto selects Precise for compact weapons and Fast for massive assault rifle trees.
